llm.evidence: Embedded AI is AI integrated directly into a physical product or software application, so it becomes part of the device itself or the application’s workflow.
llm.note: The first two sentences define embedded AI and where it can run, but do not answer the H1’s questions about benefits, use cases, and tools; broaden the opening answer.
llm.fragment: Embedded AI is AI integrated directly

llm.note: This is an informational article about embedded AI, not a recruiting page.

llm.evidence: This guide is for engineering leaders and product teams deciding where AI belongs in a product they already ship.
llm.note: The page targets teams learning how to build embedded AI into products, not companies ready to hire Data and AI engineers.
llm.fragment: This guide is for engineering leaders

llm.note: No Glossary §6 hiring term best matches this informational embedded AI article.
